description: Takes a B2B SaaS onto Microsoft Marketplace (formerly AppSource and Azure Marketplace) and the Teams store as a publisher - transactable SaaS offer, choices locked at publish, Teams and Microsoft 365 app validation, Publisher Attestation, Teams-linked SaaS, private offers, co-sell and Azure IP co-sell (MACC) eligibility. Use whenever a vendor mentions AppSource, Microsoft Marketplace, the Teams store, a Partner Center offer, Microsoft co-sell, MACC eligibility, Frontier Accelerate or ISV Success. Do NOT use for listing copy or rank (use samber/developer-platform-skills@integration-listing-optimization), running your own marketplace (use samber/developer-platform-skills@app-marketplace-review), Teams bot code, Windows Store apps, services co-sell, or spending MACC as a buyer.
